# testdata/nav_stack.sngl's program, run on each target passNavigation lowers
# sngl:ui/nav for, on android, which answers it with a NavHost
# (testdata/nav_stack_android.txtar), and on the interpreter, which answers it from the checked
# IR and is the reference the others are held to. A stack starts at the page
# at "/", `go` and a link show another and push, `back` restores the page and
# its params, and a page not showing is not mounted: the effect on the home
# page mounts again each time it comes back.
#
# The tests read the component's state, its own handles, a page's record and
# the heading's value -- a one-way prop, which a test reads as the expression
# its call site gave. Not nav_stack.sngl's reads of a label in a page's content
# or of a counter nested in one: a node there is rendered only while its page
# shows, and a component there is built at run time on the targets that keep
# an instance's state, so neither is one thing a compiled test can name. So
# the params a page shows are what an effect keyed on them in its content saw.
#
# testdata/nav_stack_lowered.txtar is the code.
#
# html answers a stack with a document per page (testdata/nav_stack_html.txtar),
# and a test runs inside the document it was loaded in: a `go` or a link loads
# another, which ends the run. And a static site cannot serve app.sngl's
# `/p/{name}`, a pattern. So html runs static.sngl, the part a document
# answers on its own -- the page it starts at, read through the stack, and that
# the page it is not is not there at all -- beside the interpreter, which holds
# the program to the same answers.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none static.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html static.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pkg {
    name string
}

struct Meta {
    label string
}

component site ui.node {
    var mounts = 0
    var seen = ""
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About", meta=Meta{label="about"}) {
            ui.text(value="about")
        }
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home", meta=Meta{label="home"}) {
            ui.text(value="home")
            effect(@mount {
                mounts += 1
            })
        }
        nav.page #pkg(href=`/p/{name}`, title="Package", meta=Meta{label="pkg"}, params=Pkg{name="first"}) {
            component content(p) {
                ui.text(value=p.name)
                effect(on=p.name, @mount {
                    seen = p.name
                })
            }
        }
    }
    ui.text #heading(value="Site - {pages.current.title}")
    ui.button #toAbout(text="About", @click {
        pages.go(about)
    })
    ui.button #toPkg(text="Pkg", @click {
        pages.go(pkg)
    })
    ui.button #toOther(text="Other", @click {
        pages.go(pkg, Pkg{name="other"})
    })
    ui.button #back(text="Back", @click {
        pages.back()
    })
    nav.link #aboutLink(to=about, text="about")
    nav.link #linked(to=pkg, params=Pkg{name="linked"}, text="linked")
}

func testAStackStartsAtTheRootPage(t Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
    t.assert(c.pages.current.title == "Home")
    t.assert(c.pages.current.meta.label == "home")
    t.assert(c.heading.value == "Site - Home")
}

func testGoShowsThePageAndBackReturns(t Test, c site) {
    c.toAbout.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.about)
    t.assert(c.pages.current.title == "About")
    t.assert(c.heading.value == "Site - About")
    c.back.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
    c.back.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
}

func testParamsTravelWithTheEntry(t Test, c site) {
    c.toPkg.click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "first")
    c.toOther.click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "other")
    c.back.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.pkg)
    t.assert(c.seen == "first")
}

func testALinkGoesToItsPage(t Test, c site) {
    c.aboutLink.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.about)
    c.linked.click()
    t.assert(c.seen == "linked")
}

func testAPageNotShowingIsNotMounted(t Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.mounts == 1)
    c.toAbout.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 1)
    c.back.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 2)
}
-- static.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Meta {
    label string
}

component site ui.node {
    var homeMounts = 0
    var aboutMounts = 0
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About", meta=Meta{label="about"}) {
            ui.text(value="about")
            effect(@mount {
                aboutMounts += 1
            })
        }
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home", meta=Meta{label="home"}) {
            ui.text(value="home")
            effect(@mount {
                homeMounts += 1
            })
        }
    }
    ui.text(value="Site - {pages.current.title}")
    nav.link #aboutLink(to=about, text="about")
}

func testAStackStartsAtTheRootPage(t Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
    t.assert(c.pages.current != c.about)
    t.assert(c.pages.current.title == "Home")
    t.assert(c.pages.current.meta.label == "home")
}

func testAPageNotShowingIsNotMounted(t Test, c site) {
    t.assert(c.homeMounts == 1)
    t.assert(c.aboutMounts == 0)
}
